description: Request a custom Jinja (HTML) print format for a DocType, or change, disable, enable it, or make it the default (checked, rendered on a real document, needs approval)

name.description: Print Format name (3-140 characters). Must be new for create

doc_type.description: DocType it prints (create only), e.g. Sales Invoice

html.description: Jinja template. Context: doc, meta, letter_head, footer, no_letterhead, print_settings, _(), frappe.format/frappe.utils. Do not write, send or read without permission (frappe.db.*, frappe.get_all)

default_print_format.description: With create/update/enable: 1 makes it the DocType's default (Property Setter, like Customize Form); 0 removes it as default

sample_document.description: Name of the document to render the preview on; default: the latest one you can read

purpose.description: One line, shown on the card and kept as a Jinja comment in the template
